tools.name: task_list_add
tools.description: Add a task to the user's task queue. Use whenever the user asks to add/track/remember a to-do, action item, or commitment ("add to my tasks", "put this on my list", "track this", "I need to do X later"). Provide a short `title` and, when the task needs real instructions to execute, an `execution_prompt` with the full detail. After enqueueing, Cue auto-triages the item (urgency + priority) and — when the user's autonomy policy allows — runs it in the background and brings the result back for review. Dedupes on title by default. Pass `assignee` to delegate the item to a roster agent; call agent_roster first to see who exists and what each is scoped to.

title.description: Short, user-facing task title (imperative, e.g. "Book the Uber for tomorrow morning").

execution_prompt.description: Full instruction the executor should receive at run time — include every detail needed to do the work cold (paths, names, links). Defaults to notes/title when omitted.

notes.description: Optional context shown with the task.

priority_tier.description: 0 = high, 1 = medium, 2 = low. Omit to let auto-triage score it.

required_tools.description: Optional explicit tool allowlist snapshot for the run.

if_exists.description: Duplicate handling when an active item with the same title exists (default reuse_existing).

task_id.description: Enqueue from a saved task template by id (instead of ad-hoc title).

task_name.description: Enqueue from a saved task template by name.

assignee.description: Hand this work to a named agent from the roster (call agent_roster first — the name must match exactly, and an unknown name is rejected rather than silently run by the house assistant). "you" parks it for the owner. Omit to run as the house assistant.

tools.name: task_list_show
tools.description: Show the user's task queue. Use when the user asks what's on their list / task queue / what's pending, running, awaiting review, or done. Optionally filter by status.

status.description: Optional status filter: queued | running | awaiting_review | done | failed | cancelled | archived.

tools.name: task_list_update
tools.description: Update a task on the queue — change priority, notes, sort order, or status (e.g. approve an awaiting_review item to done). Select the item by work_item_id (preferred), task_id, task_name, or title.

status.description: New status. Note: done is only reachable from awaiting_review.

tools.name: task_list_remove
tools.description: Remove a task from the queue (when the user says it's no longer needed). Select by work_item_id (preferred), task_name, or title.

tools.name: task_queue_run
tools.description: Start executing a queued task in the background right now (the user says "run it", "do it now", "go ahead with that task"). Select by work_item_id (preferred), task_name, or title. Returns immediately; the run reports back to the Review lane when finished.

tools.name: agent_roster
tools.description: List the owner's agents: name, domain, charter, autonomy tier, spend against cap, tool scopes, and model pin. Read this before delegating with task_list_add's `assignee` — assignee matching is by exact name, and it also tells you whether an agent is paused, near its cap, or scoped away from the work you were about to hand it.
